english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something becomes different or turns into something else.
This is the all-purpose choice when something changes over time or is not constant.
Use 變 when something becomes different, especially without emphasizing who deliberately changed it.
Use this for a change of state, with complements such as 變成 or 變壞 for becoming something or going bad.
Use this for something undergoing a change in appearance or character, often with 咗 or 緊.

examples.english: The weather is starting to change and get cold.
examples.jyutping: tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 bin3 dung3 laa3

examples.english: The price of this fruit will vary with the season.
examples.traditional: 呢款水果嘅價錢會隨住季節變。
examples.jyutping: nei1 fun2 seoi2 gwo2 ge3 gaa3 cin4 wui5 ceoi4 zyu6 gwai3 zit3 bin3

examples.english: The situation can alter very quickly.

examples.english: After the renovation, the room will transform and look much nicer.
